description:
Two issues in `src/fetcher/public_suffix.cr`:

**1. Dead nil-check (line 83):**
```crystal
def self.registrable_domain(domain : String) : String?
  return nil if domain.nil? || domain.empty?   # domain can't be nil
```
The parameter type is `String` (non-nilable), so `domain.nil?` is unreachable. Drop it.

**2. Loose IP regex (line 86):**
```crystal
return domain if domain.match(%r{^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$})
```
A hand-rolled regex that accepts `999.999.999.999`. Use `Socket::IPAddress.new(domain, 0)` for proper IPv4 validation, matching the pattern used elsewhere in the codebase (see `url_validator.cr:looks_like_ip?`). Catch `Socket::Error` to return false.

Acceptance: `registrable_domain("999.999.999.999")` returns nil; `registrable_domain("192.168.1.1")` returns "192.168.1.1"; full spec suite passes; `public_suffix_spec.cr` covers the change.
title: Fix public_suffix dead nil-check and loose IP regex
